headline: Copper Prices Fall to Multi-Month Lows on Global Demand Concerns
summary: Copper prices dropped to their lowest levels since March following a weekly market decline driven by investor worries over global industrial consumption.
why: Copper is an essential raw material for construction, electronics, and power grids, serving as a key bellwether for international industrial activity.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Copper prices fell to their lowest level since March due to global demand fears.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Copper market prices fell sharply on heightened concerns over global economic slowdown and weaker industrial demand.
